# Add Shared Blazor Component

Create a new reusable Razor Component for the shared Razor Class Library.

**Component name and purpose:** [USER DESCRIPTION]

Requirements:
- Must work both in Blazor Web (Server + WebAssembly + Auto) and in MAUI Blazor Hybrid
- Use modern .NET 10 Blazor syntax
- Proper parameters, EventCallback, RenderFragment
- Full support for dark/light theme if the project has it
- Responsive design
- XML documentation
- Code-behind (.razor.cs) only when logic is complex

Place the component in the correct folder inside the shared library.
